metadata.title: Manage-FreeIPA
metadata.description: Add few PowerShell cmdlets to manage a FreeIPA server through his JSONRPC web API - https://github.com/freeipa/freeipa

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Invoke-FreeIPAAPIstageuser_add' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.
